title: Fable rank 50
problem: "On-debuff effects activate 1 additional time": only Unbound Hatred repeats.
notes: Fix: H 2026-10-26 hook batch B2 built (research/hooks_B2.json, loader/hooks_B2.c). The debuff case's Unbound Hatred repeat bound (scr_PerkLevel(367) @0x1410f018b, re-read every pass) reads one higher when the debuffed creature bears Fable rank 50 (scr_CritHasRelicPerk(creature, 29, 5), the buff case's own test), so on-debuff reactions run one extra pass, adding to Unbound Hatred. Scope: the bearer side of the text (as the buff case); the relic's own on-debuff effects have no separate debuff-case code. In-game test: Give a creature Fable 50 and a trait that reacts when it is debuffed (e.g. a gain-on-debuff trait); have an enemy debuff it: the reaction fires twice (three times with Unbound Hatred). Without Fable 50: once.

release_notes.intended: Your creatures' on-debuff effects activate 1 additional time.
release_notes.actual: In the unpatched game, only Unbound Hatred got the extra activation.
release_notes.fix: Now your creatures' on-debuff effects activate the additional time. Partial: the relic's own on-debuff effects are not repeated.
